inline_comments.comment: Two issues with the changeset message: (1) The prefix `docs:` is not in the project's allowed list — only `feat:`, `fix:`, or `chore:` are permitted. Since this corrects incorrect documentation, `fix:` is appropriate. (2) The first word of the description after the prefix must be capitalized per project convention. The corrected message should read: `fix: Fix incorrect image node documentation`.

"E.g." at the end of the sentence is a bare abbreviation that reads as an awkward fragment before the code block. Consider replacing it with a complete lead-in, for example: "...set `constraint: on` to constrain the aspect ratio:" (ending the sentence with a colon) or "For example:" on its own line.

The code fence uses ` ```mermaid ` but every other diagram example in this source file uses ` ```mermaid-example `. The `docs.mts` build script treats both identically — `'mermaid'` is included in `MERMAID_EXAMPLE_KEYWORDS`, so both produce the same `mermaid-example` + `mermaid` pair in the generated `docs/` output. However, using `mermaid-example` here would be consistent with the rest of the file.
